aboutGame.title: What is The Hollow?
paragraphs: The Hollow is Roblox's 2026 platform-wide Halloween survival event from Roblox Presents. It opened on October 22 at 2 p.m. PT, adds a new maze and monster each day for nine days, and hosts a live finale on the morning of October 31.

Players explore the event hub, search for clues, avoid monsters drawn from nine horror games, and complete quests for exclusive UGC and survival rewards. Reward collection remains open until noon PST on November 2, 2026.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about The Hollow event dates, access, monsters, quests, and rewards.

items.question: What is The Hollow?
items.answer: The Hollow is Roblox's 2026 Halloween survival event from Roblox Presents. It centers on a shared event hub with a changing maze, nine daily monster appearances, quests, and exclusive UGC rewards.

items.question: When does The Hollow start and end?
items.answer: The Hollow opened on October 22, 2026, at 2 p.m. PT. Its live finale begins on the morning of October 31, and players can collect rewards until noon PST on November 2.

items.question: Do you need Roblox Plus to play The Hollow?
items.answer: No. The Hollow is available to eligible Roblox or Roblox Select account holders. Active Plus subscribers received early hub access at noon PT on opening day and additional event perks.

items.question: Which monsters appear in The Hollow?
items.answer: The Hollow features The Deer, Seek, Twisted Dandy, Piggy, The Inspector, Mimic, Biter, Hiachi, and The Overseer. Roblox has not assigned each monster a specific date in its announcement.

items.question: How do you earn rewards in The Hollow?
items.answer: Complete quests in The Hollow to earn exclusive UGC and rewards that can help you survive. Marketplace Halloween items, including the Hollow Horseman, are sold separately from quest rewards.

items.question: Where do you play The Hollow?
items.answer: The Hollow takes place inside Roblox through its official event experience and shared hub. An eligible Roblox account is required, and age or access rules vary by region.
